execution.question: Does one Monte Carlo EM covariance-learning step under the original-source raw likelihood improve its source-only expected complete-data objective while retaining the structural core and equal-information GP control?
execution.objective: Use Stage203 posterior sufficient moments E[(f-m)(f-m)^T] from the ORIGINAL48 raw source batches. Minimize Q(theta)=.5/48*(48log(2pi)+logdet K(theta)+trace(K(theta)^-1 E[(f-m)(f-m)^T])). This is the expected negative Gaussian f-prior log density in the same hierarchical raw source model,with the eta law fixed. No new posterior draws or labels needed for this ONE M step. Posterior means and covariance include the between-eta term. Do not mistake Q improvement for verified marginal raw likelihood improvement.
execution.parameters: Structural: ORIGINAL common/task root amplitudes and spectral exponents,p in[0,4];source-derived correlation templates,active support,order2,orthogonal basis,separate positive tails,intercept variances,white discrepancy and center fixed. GP: ORIGINAL common/task RBF amplitudes,task intercept and white discrepancy;lengthscales,common intercept,normalization and center fixed. Four parameters per arm;nonnegative original amplitude bounds,including exact zeros. Risk population law/coordinate remain fixed empirical source estimates.
execution.verification: At original parameters,the new Q gradient must reproduce Stage204 raw score at1e-8 before optimization. Retain PSD/positive-tail and original support properties. Singular GP latent covariance on its allowed zero-amplitude boundary has infinite Q for the full-rank posterior sufficient statistic;handle that as its mathematical objective domain,without a jitter/floor or relaxed bounds. Record each reached optimizer and projected gradient. Reached Q must improve versus old parameters in the full posterior and separately in BOTH split posterior moment summaries. Stop any nonconverged or split-failing candidate without extra optimization restarts.
execution.decision: If all four source M-step candidates pass,register a fresh original-source raw posterior update under the learned covariances,then an honest development predictive-mixture comparison. Do not attach current old-posterior moments to the new covariance as if already reconditioned. No Gaussian collapse for paid target updates,no covariance selection by held-task MSE,and no outer task1 or independent confirmation.
execution.execution: local serial single-thread;posterior sufficient moments and original covariance derivatives only;small JSON,no NPZ or server work
execution.scope: Source covariance-learning pilot under the raw likelihood,not a complete EM fit or decision improvement. Original orthogonal,sparse,low-order,low-frequency prior constraints remain. Earlier sampler/candidate failures retained;complete-model HOLD.
execution.numerical_optimization_coordinates: Optimize theta_j/initial_theta_j for positive starting parameters,and unit scale for zero starts. This changes numerical units only,preserves all original bounds/exact zeros,and is fixed before optimization. Record gradients in both coordinates.
